response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong general software engineering expertise and experience across diverse technologies, he lacks the mandatory technical depth required for this role. His C++ professional experience spans only approximately 6 months (National Instruments, 2014-2015), significantly short of the required 5-10 years. More critically, he has no demonstrable experience in financial services, capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking—areas where domain expertise is explicitly required. His career has focused on web platforms, mobile apps, and geospatial systems, making this a fundamental mismatch despite his technical capabilities.
strengths: 17+ years of software development experience with proven ability to master diverse technologies and domains
Strong software engineering practices including CI/CD infrastructure, testing, and technical mentorship
Solid Java background and some C++ exposure providing foundation for systems-level development
concerns: C++ professional experience (~6 months) drastically falls short of the 5-10 year mandatory requirement
Completely lacks required domain expertise in financial services, capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking
Career trajectory in web, mobile, and open-source development rather than capital markets systems
